mapper.select: SELECT membership.tenant_id, membership.subject_id, membership.membership_id, membership.password_hash, membership.permission_version FROM organization_access.tenant tenant INNER JOIN organization_access.membership_credential membership ON membership.tenant_id = tenant.tenant_id WHERE tenant.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND tenant.status = 'ENABLED' AND membership.login_name = #{loginName} AND membership.status = 'ENABLED'
